name: Jump Buffer
description: Predictive jump buffer: if a jump would die, delay it to the earliest safe 240 Hz physics tick within the configured window.

ticks.name: Buffer Window (ticks)
ticks.description: Maximum number of 240 Hz physics ticks the mod may move a jump forward. 4 ticks is about 16.7 ms.

lookahead.name: Prediction Lookahead (ticks)
lookahead.description: How far the simulation checks after a candidate jump to decide whether it dies. Larger values are more conservative but cost more CPU while predicting.

practice-only.name: Practice Mode Only
practice-only.description: Only use the buffer while Practice Mode is active.

hold-modes.name: Hold Modes
hold-modes.description: Allow predictive buffering for ship, UFO, wave, robot, spider and swing-style hold inputs. Disable if you only want cube-style jumps.
